title: Customer Priority Admission Circuit and Delivery Accelerator
creator: Ruth Alvarez
description: Create an operational framework and tooling (Admission Circuit + Delivery Accelerator) to accept, prioritize, and guarantee bounded commitments for top accounts during demand surges. This combines a numerical intake scorer, conditional SLA tiers, and a simulated capacity planner to give product and sales clear, repeatable acceptance criteria for roadmap asks.
acceptance_criteria: Scorecard algorithm defined and validated with historical intake (weights documented)
Admission Circuit UI mockups in Console with ability to mark tickets Fast-Track / Evaluate / Defer
Simulator that models 3 month runway under different intake rates and shows estimated delivery date distribution
Escalation SLA matrix (response time, commitment window, mitigation path) reviewed with Sales leadership
Pilot runbook and 2-week pilot with 3 customers scheduled and resourced
tasks: Draft scoring rubric and weights with Customer Success and Sales (owner: PM)
Run historical replays on last 18 months of requests to calibrate score distribution (owner: Data)
Wireframe Admission Circuit in Console; include explicit fallback flows (owner: Design)
Draft messaging templates for accepted/denied/conditional commitments (owner: Comms)
Run cross-functional review and signoff (owner: PM)
Schedule pilot and instrument metrics (owner: Solutions Eng)
Post-pilot retrospective and decision to generalize (owner: PM)
decisions: Use a weighted linear score (0-100) combining ARR impact, product fit, legal/regulatory risk, and technical complexity — initial weights: ARR 40, Fit 25, Risk 20, Complexity 15
Three-tier admission outcomes: Fast-Track (score>=80), Timeboxed Commitment (60-79), Defer with Scoped Alternative (<60)
Commitment windows will be probabilistic: 60% on-window, 30% within +2 cycles, 10% > +2 cycles — surfaced by simulator rather than absolute promises
Escalation path: Sales -> Solutions Eng Triage (24h) -> PM Decision (72h) with optional canary funding to accelerate engineering work
Pilot will target a mix of one strategic enterprise, one high-ARR scale-up, and one regulated customer to validate risk weighting
notes: Trade-off identified: stricter Fast-Track threshold reduces false-positive commitments but hurts enterprise goodwill — documented in tradeoffs doc.
Simulator will initially use conservative staffing assumptions (no overtime, no temporary contractors) to prevent overpromising.
We will not hard-code legal SLAs into Admission Circuit in pilot; legal signoff required before contractual language.
Consider feature-gating Admission Circuit in Console behind an enterprise flag for Dedicated/Private customers.
